source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of pie charts, x-axis figures and error bars (PDF 199-203).

blocks.text: Pie chart sectors mein bata hua gol graph hai, har sector kul ka aik hissa. Poora daira 100%, yaani 360 darje, hai aur har sector ka zawiya us qisam ke hisse ke mutanasib hai. Pie charts kul ke hisson wale categorical data, jaise cells ki qismein, species ki taqseem ya survey ke jawab, ke liye munasib hain.

blocks.caption: 100 talaba ke blood types (kitab ka survey)

items: Data ko qismon aur frequencies ke table mein rakhein.
Har sector ka zawiya nikalein: (qisam ki qeemat / kul) x 360.
Daira bana kar protractor se shuruati radius se baari baari har zawiya lagayein, mukhtalif rang use karein.
Har sector ka naam likhein, zaroorat ho to legend aur wazeh unwan dein.

blocks.alt: 100 talaba ke blood groups ka pie chart: O 40% (sab se bara hissa, surkh), A 30% (neela), B 20% (hara) aur AB 10% (peela). Legend har group ke talaba aur zawiya batata hai: A 108, B 72, AB 36 aur O 144 darje.
blocks.caption: Blood types ka pie chart (kitab ke data se asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Pie chart kul ke hisse dikhata hai: poora daira 100% ya 360 darje hai, aur har hisse ka zawiya us ka hissa zarb 360 hai. 100 talaba mein group A (30) ko 30/100 x 360 = 108 darje, B (20) ko 72, AB (10) ko 36 aur O (40) ko 144 darje milte hain; zawiye mil kar 360 darje bante hain.

blocks.text: X-axis graph ki ufqi lakeer hai, aam taur par independent variable ke liye; y-axis us ke muqable mein naapa gaya dependent variable dikhata hai. Hayatiyat mein x-axis aksar waqt, species ya tajrubati halaat dikhata hai. Figure banane ke liye: variables pehchanein; paimana aur had chunein; units ke saath axes ke naam likhein; har qeematon ka jora lagayein; aur munasib ho to nuqte jor kar rujhan dikhayein.

Kitab ki misaal mein enzyme activity paanch darja hararat par naapi gayi: (5 C, 2), (10 C, 4), (20 C, 7), (30 C, 5) aur (40 C, 3) micromole fi minute, x-axis par darja hararat aur y-axis par activity.

blocks.alt: The effect of temperature on enzyme activity naam ka line graph. X-axis par darja hararat 0 se 45 C aur y-axis par enzyme activity 0 se 8 micromole fi minute. Nuqte (5, 2), (10, 4), (20, 7), (30, 5) aur (40, 3) aik lakeer se jure jo 20 C par choti tak charh kar girti hai.
blocks.caption: Darja hararat ke muqable mein enzyme activity (kitab ke data se asal graph).
blocks.long_description: X-axis data figure mein independent variable, yahan darja hararat Celsius mein, ufqi x-axis par aur dependent variable, enzyme activity micromole fi minute mein, amoodi y-axis par hoti hai. Har naap ka jora nuqte ki shakal mein lagaya aur nuqte jor kar rujhan dikhaya jata hai: activity 5 C par 2 se barh kar 20 C par sab se zyada 7 aur 40 C par gir kar 3 hoti hai. Darja hararat sahih paimane par hain, is liye 5 se 10 C ka faasla 10 se 20 C ke faasle ka aadha hai.

blocks.title: Paimana sahih rakhein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke darja hararat barabar faasle par rakhe ja sakte hain kyunke waqfe milte julte hain, lekin un ke darmiyan 5, 10, 10 aur 10 darje ka farq hai. Sahih paimane par, jaisa yahan bana hai, 5 se 10 C ka faasla baqiyon ka aadha hai.

Bar chart par error bars har bar ke peeche data ka bikhrao ya ghair yaqeeni pan dikhate hain, yaani alag qeematein bar ke dikhaye mean se aam taur par kitni door hain. Range error bars group ki sab se chhoti se sab se bari qeemat tak jate hain. Standard deviation error bars mean se aik ya zyada standard deviation oopar aur neeche jate hain (mean jama ya minus SD). Har sire par chhoti ufqi topi banayi jati hai.

blocks.caption: Teen roshniyon mein lobia ke paudon ki unchai (kitab ka data, cm)

blocks.alt: Kam, darmiyani aur zyada roshni mein lobia ke paudon ki ausat unchai ka bar chart: 10, 15 aur 19 cm. Har bar par topi wala kaala error bar, 9 se 11, 14 se 16 aur 18 se 20 cm, yaani har group ke teen paudon ki range.
blocks.caption: Error bars ke saath paudon ki ausat unchai (kitab ke data se asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Error bars har bar ke peeche data ka bikhrao dikhate hain. Yahan har bar kam, darmiyani ya zyada roshni mein uge teen lobia ke paudon ki ausat unchai hai (10, 15 aur 19 cm), aur har error bar apne group ki sab se chhoti se sab se bari qeemat tak jata hai (range error bar). Is misaal mein har group ki range 2 cm hai, is liye bars mean jama ya minus 1 cm bhi dikhate hain jise kitab taqreeban aik standard deviation kehti hai.

blocks.title: Yahan standard deviation ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab har group ki SD taqreeban 1 batati hai. Chapter ke formula se (N = 3 se taqseem) 9, 10 aur 11 ki SD taqreeban 0.82 hai; chhote sample ke liye aam tareeqe se N - 1 se taqseem karne par theek 1 aati hai. Range error bars (jama ya minus 1 cm) bilkul durust hain.

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke blood types ke zawiye mil kar poora daira bante hain.

items: Pie: zawiya = hissa x 360; poora daira 360 darje.
X-axis figure: x par independent, y par dependent, sahih paimana.
Error bars: range (min se max) ya mean +/- SD, topiyon ke saath.
